name: search_pubmed
description: Search the PubMed biomedical literature database for articles matching a free-text query. Returns a ranked list of article metadata including PMID, title, authors, journal, publication year, and abstract. Use this tool when the user asks to find scientific papers, literature reviews, or evidence on a biomedical topic. Do NOT use for non-biomedical literature (e.g. CS papers — use arXiv tools instead).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search query using PubMed query syntax. Supports Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT) and MeSH terms. Example: 'BRCA1 AND breast cancer AND (therapy OR treatment)'. Should be a complete query string, not just keywords.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return, ranked by PubMed relevance score. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Earliest publication year to include (inclusive), as a 4-digit year e.g. 2020. Articles published before this year are excluded. Omit to include all years.

articles.description: List of matching articles, ranked by relevance. Each item has: pmid (string), title (string), authors (array of strings), journal (string), year (integer), abstract (string).

total_count.description: Total number of matches in PubMed, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object with 'articles' (list of metadata) and 'total_count' (total matches before truncation).
